setup.zh: 离堆的石头被凿开了一道口，江水从口里分出去。一头大牛站在口前，身子像一座小山，重有千斤。它一低头就撞向堰，一撞，堰就裂开一道缝。它的眼睛看着山下——鼎在山底下醒了，它以为是李冰回来了。
setup.en: The rock of Lidui has been cut through, and the river splits through the cut. Before it stands a great ox, its body like a small hill, a thousand jin in weight. It lowers its head and drives at the weir, and each blow opens a new crack. Its eyes are on the ground below the hill — the cauldron has woken under the mountain, and the ox thinks Li Bing has come back.

recap.zh: 离堆的堰前，一头千斤的夔牛在撞堰——它以为山底下醒来的是李冰。
recap.en: Before the weir at Lidui a thousand-jin Kui ox was ramming the dam — it thought what had woken under the mountain was Li Bing.

text.zh: 是夔牛，岷山里的大牛。它不是来毁堰的——它是来跟李冰再斗一回。
text.en: It's a Kui ox, the great ox of the Min hills. It hasn't come to break the weir — it has come to fight Li Bing once more.

alone.zh: 是夔牛——岷山多夔牛。它不是来毁堰的，是来跟李冰再斗一回。
alone.en: A Kui ox — the Min hills are full of them. It has not come to break the weir, but to fight Li Bing once more.

text.zh: 夔牛转过头来，鼻子里喷着白气。它先要问你一句。
text.en: The ox turns its head, white breath jetting from its nostrils. First it has a question.

exits.means: fights the ox, stops it ramming the weir by force

withdrawn.zh: 夔牛退到江里，喘着气。明夜它还会来。
withdrawn.en: The ox backs into the river, panting. Tomorrow night it will come again.

text.zh: 夔牛跪下了前腿，角抵在地上，不再撞了。
text.en: The ox goes down on its forelegs, horns to the ground, and rams no more.

text.zh: 堰保住了。鼎在山那边——石纽。
text.en: The weir holds. The cauldron is beyond the hill — at Shiniu.

alone.zh: 堰保住了。鼎在山那边的石纽。
alone.en: The weir holds. The cauldron lies beyond the hill, at Shiniu.

text.zh: 你答了。夔牛眨了眨眼，喷出一口白气，慢慢卧了下来。
text.en: You answer. The ox blinks, blows out a white breath, and slowly lies down.

alone.zh: 它卧下了。石纽在山那边。
alone.en: It lies down. Shiniu is beyond the hill.

label.en: Dig the bed deep, keep the weir low

exits.means: does as Li Bing taught: digs the riverbed deeper and lowers the weir, lets the water find its own way instead of fighting it

text.zh: 你想起离堆石壁上刻的六个字：深淘滩，低作堰。你不堵水，把滩底淘深，把堰放低。江水从分水口流过去，不再往堰上撞。夔牛看着水走，看了很久，卧了下来——李冰没回来，可他的法子回来了。
text.en: You remember six characters cut in the cliff at Lidui: dig the bed deep, keep the weir low. You do not dam the water; you dig the shoals deeper and lower the weir. The river flows through the cut and stops hammering the dam. The ox watches the water go for a long time, then lies down — Li Bing has not come back, but his way has.
The water found its own way.

alone.en: The water has found its own way.

exits.means: runs from the ox, turns back, refuses to act

text.zh: 你往回走。身后又是一声闷响——堰又裂开了一道。
text.en: You turn back. Behind you another boom — another crack in the weir.

alone.zh: 你往回走。身后又是一声闷响；堰又裂开了一道。
alone.en: You turn back. Behind you another boom: another crack in the weir.
